text:
alex_sales: Quick sync — Lynx (prospect) asked for a short POC flood test tomorrow 9am PT. Primary goal: validate sustained 180-220 QPS on the chat/generation endpoint with p95 <= 2s. They require encryption at rest using their KMS and want cost range ~ $3k for the run. Can SE/Eng confirm runbook + any blockers?

tanya_se: Gotcha. A few clarifying q's: single region or multi-region? payload avg token size? streaming or non-streaming responses? Also do they want prefix caching enabled?

alex_sales: Single region (US-WEST1). Avg prompt ~ 60 tokens, response ~ 120 tokens. Non-streaming is fine. Prefers prefix caching OFF for accuracy/backpressure reasons.

ben_eng: Plan suggestion: single region us-west1, model: redwood-open-large-v1 (quantized L4x), warm-up 30m to prime KV cache (even if prefix cache off, kv warms decoder), ramp 10m to target, sustain 60m, cool down 5m. Metrics: p50/p95/p99, 1m token/s, errors, CPU/GPU utilization. Note: hosted shared pool can hit jitter — for strict p95 target recommend Dedicated or small reserved capacity.

ben_eng: Load generator config (wrk-like) we use for this test:

```
{
  "target_qps": 200,
  "concurrency": 200,
  "duration": "75m",
  "ramp_up": "10m",
  "payload": {"prompt": "<sample 60-token prompt>", "max_tokens": 150},
  "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer <test-key>", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
}
```

ben_eng: Notes: run from 3 client machines to avoid client-side bottleneck. Use separate metrics stream to capture token-level cost and per-request latency. Add occasional single-request cold-start probes (1/min) to measure worst-case.

priya_platform: KMS note: hosted supports customer-managed keys on GCP/AWS KMS; HSM-only is available in Private deployments. If Lynx insists on HSM-backed keys we'll need Private + ent legal. Also to hit reliable p95 <2s we should provision Dedicated with 2-3 GPUs behind the pool and pin model variant. I'll request quota.

alex_sales: @priya_platform please request dedicated quota and confirm pricing delta. Can we still run a hosted baseline first?

priya_platform: Yes run hosted baseline first (lower cost, more variance). I'll open the quota request and ping infra. ETA 6-8 hours.

deploy-bot: loadtest-runner: job started by alex_sales — id lt-1798854321-1 (baseline hosted run).

ben_eng: After baseline run (notes): sustained QPS = 210, p50 = 95ms, p95 = 320ms, p99 = 780ms. Observed periodic tail spikes ~700-1k ms correlated with GC on worker pods during token-heavy requests. Error rate <0.05%. Token burn ~ 45k tokens/sec peak.

ben_eng: Quick optimization attempt: switch to quantized kernel profile L4x-8bit + batch_size=4 -> rerun short 15m sweep. Result: p95 dropped to 190ms, p99 380ms, sustained QPS still ~205. Cost estimate dropped ~22% vs baseline.

ben_eng: Actionable recommendations:
- For p95 <= 200ms: use Dedicated pool + quantized kernel profile + batch_size 4-8.
- Enable autoscaling with minimal headroom to avoid cold starts during spikes.
- If customer requires HSM, move to Private (adds infra + license cost).

alex_sales: Perfect — I'm going to summarize and send to Lynx. Action items: priya to request dedicated quota & pricing delta, tanya to schedule the 9am PT focused run and share load-generator VMs, ben will provide final load script + short checklist.

tanya_se: On it. I'll also attach the small-run logs and perf graphs after the 9am run.

alex_sales: Thanks team! Will flag if customer requests HSM or longer soak. :thumbsup:
